LESSON: FISHING IN EASTERN AFRICA

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: RESOURCES AND ECONOMIC ACTIVITIES IN EASTERN AFRICA Strand Sub- Strand Specific 
Topic 3.2: Fishing in Eastern Africa

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Fishing in Eastern Africa. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is fishing important to the Eastern Africa communitie s?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe methods of marine fishing in Eastern Africa
2. explain challenges facing fishing in Eastern Africa

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: FISHING IN EASTERN AFRICA
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES · Grade: Grade 6
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Fishing in Eastern Africa helps you succeed in SOCIAL STUDIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

KEY FACTS: FISHING IN EASTERN AFRICA
Good citizens follow rules, respect others, and care for shared places.
Kenyan examples: lining up, keeping the compound clean, telling the truth, helping a classmate.
Rights come with responsibilities.

PART 1: Describe methods of marine fishing in Eastern Africa

What this means
In this part you learn to describe methods of marine fishing in Eastern Africa. You will use ideas from in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe methods of marine fishing in Eastern Africa.
2. Locate, explain, then act responsibly using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Locate: Connect “Fishing in Eastern Africa” to a real place or group in Kenya (school, market, county office, home).

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe methods of marine fishing in Eastern Africa. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Explain challenges facing fishing in Eastern Africa

What this means
In this part you learn to explain challenges facing fishing in Eastern Africa. You will use ideas from in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain challenges facing fishing in Eastern Africa.
2. Locate, explain, then act responsibly using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Explain: Give one cause and one effect linked to Fishing in Eastern Africa.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain challenges facing fishing in Eastern Africa. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Fishing in Eastern Africa is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Good citizens follow rules, respect others, and care for shared places.

Kenyan examples: lining up, keeping the compound clean, telling the truth, helping a classmate.

Example 1: Connect “Fishing in Eastern Africa” to a real place or group in Kenya (school, market, county office, home). (skill: describe methods of marine fishing in Eastern Africa)

Example 2: Give one cause and one effect linked to Fishing in Eastern Africa. (skill: explain challenges facing fishing in Eastern Africa)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Fishing in Eastern Africa to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: describe methods of marine fishing in Eastern Africa.
3. Practise this skill: explain challenges facing fishing in Eastern Africa.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Fishing in Eastern Africa from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Fishing in Eastern Africa: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 6 learner study Fishing in Eastern Africa?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is fishing important to the Eastern Africa communitie s?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Fishing in Eastern Africa means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: describe methods of marine fishing in Eastern Africa.
5. Be able to: explain challenges facing fishing in Eastern Africa.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
